sections.title: Getting Started
sections.body:
This hub is your backyard briefing. Pick a topic on the left, or step through with Back and Next.

Your goal is simple: plant a living wall, collect sun, and stop zombies from reaching the house. Everything else is flavor on top of that loop.

sections.title: Basic Gameplay
sections.body:
The lawn is a grid. Zombies pick a row and walk left. Plants occupy tiles and fight in their own way.

1. Collect sun.
2. Choose a seed packet.
3. Plant it on an empty tile.
4. Watch the row. Replant what gets eaten.

If a zombie reaches the left edge, that row's mower may save you once. After that, the house is open.

sections.title: Plants
sections.body:
Every plant has a job.

Producers make sun.
Shooters attack down their row.
Walls buy time.
Instant plants explode, freeze, or clear a surprise.
Special plants change the board: oil, water, graves, and more.

Read the seed packet before you plant. A peashooter in the wrong row is just a snack.

sections.title: Zombies
sections.body:
Basic zombies chew plants. Armored zombies take more hits. Special zombies break rules: they jump, fly, crush, or spawn friends.

Watch the seed bar and the wave banner. When the flag comes, spend your savings. Do not wait for the last tile.

sections.title: Sun
sections.body:
Sun is your only planting currency on most boards. Click every sun you see. Missed sun is a missed wall.

Early game: plant producers first.
Mid game: keep producing while you fill lanes.
Late game: you should have spare sun for emergencies.

If you are broke, you are already losing the next wave.

sections.title: Plant Food
sections.body:
Plant Food is rare and loud. It makes one plant do something spectacular.

Use it to break a jammed row, to harvest a burst of sun, or to stall a zombie that slipped through.

It is not a substitute for a real defense. A well-placed wall plus a shooter still wins more games than a panic feed.

sections.title: Boost
sections.body:
Boosts supercharge a plant type for a level. Boost the plants that define your plan, not the ones you plant once.

If your board is built around a stall-and-shoot lane, boost the shooter. If you need sun, boost the producer.

sections.title: Cards
sections.body:
Seed cards are your hand. Each has a sun cost and a recharge.

You cannot spam the same plant instantly. After planting, wait for the packet to glow again.

A good hand covers sun, stall, damage, and one answer to the board's gimmick.

sections.title: Battlefield
sections.body:
Not every lawn is grass. Some rows are water, oil, graves, or rails. Those tiles reject the usual plants or need special ones.

Look at the board before the first zombie. If a row is water, pack a water plant. If graves block tiles, clear or work around them.

sections.title: Special Mechanics
sections.body:
Lawn mowers, Plant Food, conveyor cards, locked tiles, and chapter gimmicks all change the script.

Read the level intro. If the board gives you free cards, plant faster. If it hides sun, protect your producers.

sections.title: Tips & Tricks
sections.body:
Plant sun first.
Never leave a lane empty.
Keep one stall plant ready.
Spend Plant Food on the wave, not the scout.
Click sun the moment it appears.
If a mower fires, rebuild that row immediately.

sections.title: Advanced Gameplay
sections.body:
Late boards reward plans, not panic. Count the sun you will have when the flag hits. Leave tiles for instant answers.

Stack roles in a lane: producer, stall, damage. When a zombie type counters your damage, swap the answer before the wave, not during it.

Most losses start as a greedy early plant. Slow down, then snowball.
